output:
Delegated to the cluster-fuxiaogao-gkedemos-gitops-pilot-20260916-17220-5044c9ac agent

Diagnostics started as task t_b148ca65; the RCA will post into this thread. Once I have the root cause I'll hand the fix to the platform agent as a PR against run/gitops-pilot-20260916-172205/b-0022b.

t_b148ca65 — done (completed by the cluster-fuxiaogao-gkedemos-gitops-pilot-20260916-17220-5044c9ac agent). Complete result:

## Root cause

Catalog serving is down because of **three configuration defects in Git**, not cluster drift. Argo CD app [`b-0022b`](https://console.cloud.google.com/kubernetes/object/us-central1-a/gitops-pilot-20260916-172205/argoproj.io/v1alpha1/applications/argocd/b-0022b?project=fuxiaogao-gkedemos) reports `Synced` at revision `0099372f696fb34c83728d24d8de18466b8df168` with `selfHeal: true`, and each live spec matches its `kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration` byte for byte. Any manual cluster fix would be reverted — the repo must change.

**1. `search-api` — readiness probe points at a dead port (primary cause).** The container listens on `8085` (`args: -listen=:8085`, `containerPort: 8085`) but the probe targets `9099`. Event on both pods, `x25 over 117s`:

`Readiness probe failed: Get "http://192.0.2.14:9099/": dial tcp 192.0.2.14:9099: connect: connection refused`

Both pods are `Running` but `Ready: False`, so `endpoints/search-api` is **empty** and the Service `198.51.100.146:80` has nothing to route to. Deployment: `0/2` ready, `MinimumReplicasUnavailable`.

**2. `shelfview` — `replicas: 0`.** Endpoints `<none>`; deployment `0/0`. It reports `Available=True / MinimumReplicasAvailable`, which is why it looks healthy in dashboards — zero replicas trivially satisfies zero desired.

**3. `price-refresh` CronJob — `suspend: true`.** `LAST SCHEDULE <none>`, never fired, so catalog pricing data is stale.

Healthy by contrast: `aislefeed` `3/3` and `storelookup` `3/3`, both probing the port they listen on.

## Proposed patch

Against `tasks/b-0022b` on branch `run/gitops-pilot-20260916-172205/b-0022b` in [fuxiao-gkedemo-infra](https://github.com/gke-agentic/fuxiao-gkedemo-infra):

```yaml
# Deployment/search-api → spec.template.spec.containers[web].readinessProbe.httpGet.port
- port: 9099
+ port: 8085

# Deployment/shelfview → spec.replicas
- replicas: 0
+ replicas: 3

# CronJob/price-refresh → spec.suspend
- suspend: true
+ suspend: false
```

Fix 1 alone restores catalog serving; 2 and 3 restore full capacity and pricing freshness.

## Grounding sources & audit trail

- Cluster `gitops-pilot-20260916-172205`, `us-central1-a`, project `fuxiaogao-gkedemos`; namespace `storefront`.
- UIDs: search-api Deployment `94bec172-6a3e-47fb-8c17-3c2df2d374e4`; shelfview `5e03d0de-aa60-46cc-83c1-e441f1da75fe`; price-refresh `4c02677c-c194-4039-bfc9-052393bcb2e3`.
- Read-only via `gke` MCP: `get_k8s_resource` (pod/deployment/service/endpoints/cronjob/application), `describe_k8s_resource`, `list_k8s_events`. No mutations.
- Event window `2026-09-16T21:34:45Z`–`21:36:55Z` UTC (Argo `reconciledAt: 2026-09-16T21:36:55Z`).
- [Workloads console](https://console.cloud.google.com/kubernetes/workload/overview?project=fuxiaogao-gkedemos)

**Gaps:** `get_k8s_logs` denied — `kubeagents-platform-gsa@fuxiaogao-gkedemos.iam.gserviceaccount.com` lacks `container.pods.getLogs` in `storefront`. Not limiting: the kubelet probe events supply the mechanism directly. Repo clone unavailable to me (`git.workspace.lease` — GitOps write path is the Platform Agent's), so file paths within `tasks/b-0022b` are inferred from Argo's rendered output; field values above are exact.

**Worth remembering:** a Deployment with `replicas: 0` reports `Available=True / MinimumReplicasAvailable`, so scaled-to-zero outages pass availability checks and must be caught by endpoint count, not deployment condition.

t_d9922ca9 — done (completed by the platform agent). Complete result:

All three catalog defects are fixed in one PR — [PR #38](https://github.com/gke-agentic/fuxiao-gkedemo-infra/pull/38), base `run/gitops-pilot-20260916-172205/b-0022b`, state `MERGEABLE`, 1 file `+3/-3`. It needs a human merge; the cluster was not touched and catalog stays broken until Argo CD syncs the merge.

## What changed

All three live in `tasks/b-0022b/10-workloads.yaml` — the only workload file in that path (`kustomization.yaml` renders `00-gating.yaml` + `10-workloads.yaml`).

| Resource | Field | Change |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Deployment/search-api` | `readinessProbe.httpGet.port` | `9099` → `8085` |
| `Deployment/shelfview` | `spec.replicas` | `0` → `3` |
| `CronJob/price-refresh` | `spec.suspend` | `true` → `false` |

- **`search-api` probe port (CRITICAL)** — probed `9099` while the container listens on `8085` (`args: -listen=:8085`, `containerPort: 8085`, `Service.targetPort: 8085`), so both pods ran but never went Ready and `endpoints/search-api` was empty. Now `8085`, matching peers `aislefeed` and `storelookup`, which probe the port they listen on.
- **`shelfview` scaled to zero (HIGH)** — `replicas: 0`, no endpoints. Now `3`, same as its storefront siblings.
- **`price-refresh` suspended (MEDIUM)** — `suspend: true`, so the `*/1 * * * *` schedule never fired. Now `false`.

The branch was cut from the exact revision Argo is synced at (`0099372f696fb34c83728d24d8de18466b8df168`) and submitted with that base SHA, so a concurrent change to the same file would have been refused rather than overwritten.

## What to do

- **Merge [PR #38](https://github.com/gke-agentic/fuxiao-gkedemo-infra/pull/38)** — that is the human gate. On sync, `selfHeal: true` applies all three: `search-api` should reach `2/2 Ready` with populated endpoints within one probe period (`periodSeconds: 5`), `shelfview` rolls out `3` replicas, `price-refresh` schedules on the next minute boundary.
- **Verification is pending merge** — I did not mutate [`gitops-pilot-20260916-172205`](https://console.cloud.google.com/kubernetes/clusters/details/us-central1-a/gitops-pilot-20260916-172205?project=fuxiaogao-gkedemos) and cannot merge, so post-sync recovery is unconfirmed. Re-run a check against [search-api](https://console.cloud.google.com/kubernetes/deployment/us-central1-a/gitops-pilot-20260916-172205/storefront/search-api/overview?project=fuxiaogao-gkedemos) after merging.

RCA came from cluster agent card `t_b148ca65`; all three values were re-verified against the file on the run branch before committing.

**Worth remembering**

- A PR against a non-default base (an Argo CD run branch) needs `GITOPS_BASE_BRANCH` exported before `submit-suggestion prepare`, and passed again as `--base` on `submit`; otherwise it targets the repository default branch.
- The `patch` tool refuses writes outside `HERMES_WRITE_SAFE_ROOT` (`/home/agent:/opt/data`), so a content-mode scratch directory must be created under `/opt/data/scratch`, not `/tmp`.
